16:32 Local Time, 10:32 GMT, 16:02 IST: The umpires have called it a day. It's already past 4.30pm in Mirpur and there's almost no chance for the light to improve going ahead. So, it's Stumps on Day 1

An intriguing opening day of Test match cricket in Mirpur as things stand on even terms. The West Indies were asked to bowl and they responded well on a slightly variable surface. The duo of Jayden Seales and Shamar Joseph bowled in probing channels with the new ball and kept the Bangladesh opening batters on their toes. Seales nicked Tanzid off to the slip cordon. Mominul looked good in his short stay before a lapse in concentration led to his downfall as Warrican struck off his second ball. Shadman was jittery initially but grew in confidence, going on to raise a gritty fifty. Even Shanto couldn’t convert his start as he was trapped in front while attempting a sweep off Warrican (WI reviewed successfully).

Shadman continued to bat with immense solidity and found an able ally in Hridoy. The latter batted proactively and kept the scoreboard moving but a left hamstring issue while running between the wickets forced him off the field on a stretcher. Shadman carried on and was nearing his century when bad light stopped play. The game restarted but only 4 overs of play were possible before bad light intervened once again to halt proceedings. Shadman was stranded on 99 and he will have to hold his nerves overnight until play resumes tomorrow morning. The game is nicely poised. Join us on Day 2 to catch all the action. Goodbye for now...
